observations: Photo 0 shows the retail packaging for a Zealot ZE21 wireless speaker.
The box is wrapped in a thin plastic film.
The brand 'ZEALOT' and model 'ZE21' are clearly printed on the front of the box.
The actual speaker is not visible; only a product illustration on the box is shown.
Icons on the bottom of the box suggest features like Bluetooth, SD card support, and water resistance.
There is a watermark for 'SAMOLINK COMPUTERS' and 'POSTED ON JIJI'.

claims.evidence: An icon on the box in photo 0 suggests water resistance, but the item itself is not shown.

risks.risk: The box may be empty or contain a damaged/different item.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual speaker outside of the packaging.

risks.risk: The internal rechargeable battery may be degraded or dead.
risks.proof: A video of the speaker powered on and playing music without being plugged in.

risks.risk: The item may be a counterfeit or clone.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's label and serial number on the device itself.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual speaker out of the box.
Photo of the back/bottom of the speaker showing the model and serial number label.
Video of the speaker powered on and playing audio.
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly identified from the retail packaging. The item can be priced at its worst-case value (non-functional/parts) since the actual device is not visible in the photos.
